en.text: Prompt gate not installed The UserPromptSubmit hook checks ONLY what a human typed by hand. Files the agent read, command output and subagent prompts go past it — that is what the proxy above sees. The hook cannot rewrite the prompt: the event does not allow it, so there are two actions — reject or warn. On a match reject the prompt warn and send A rule whose own action is “reject” stops the prompt regardless — the shared setting never downgrades it. Rules are shared with the proxy: 21 enabled, 2 of them blocking. Hook script C:\work\claude-demo-providers\.claude\hooks\agentdeck-prompt-gate.mjs

The hook cannot rewrite the prompt: the event does not allow it, so there are two actions — reject or warn. The active CLI (Codex (OpenAI)) has no “prompt submitted” event — the panel plays the gate itself, inside its own run: same rules, same journal, same script. A CLI you start from the terminal yourself will not see it. On a match reject the prompt warn and send A rule whose own action is “reject” stops the prompt regardless — the shared setting never downgrades it.
